name: Kathmandu Valley
description: Set in a bowl-shaped valley in the Nepalese Himalayas, this World Heritage site gathers seven monument groups within one crowded, lively urban area. You can wander the old royal Durbar Squares of Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur, climb to the hilltop stupa of Swayambhu, and visit the great Buddhist dome of Bauddhanath and the Hindu temples of Pashupati and Changu Narayan.
